notes.title: 0.1.0.5 is OUT!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079223/ac4f8abf5d5078019e9427ba264151b4b7681c91.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Boss, first of all, we checked our systems and resolved [b]some performance issues[/b]. Now, dynamically, the program improves FPS by disabling certain screen effects when the FPS drops to lower levels.
[*] We received information that some [b]achievements could not be obtained[/b]. [b]Fixed[/b] now!
[*] Long names on the [b]leaderboard[/b] were causing confusion with the score values. This has been[b] fixed[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: I have good news boss! 0.1.0.42 is OUT!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079223/41177e7aa890eba22360cea4df99c6aeb96e9365.png[/img]
[list]
[*] We finally made a deal with Soratech, boss! Our live stream screen now has better visuals. Additionally, we can change the FPS from the Options menu. The current options are 30, 60, 90, and 120 FPS.
[*] From now on, during the summary at the end of each wave on our live stream screen, the zombie hunters with the best headshot chain will be listed. Maybe we'll be the best :)
[*] Some errors in our system have been fixed. For example, bullets weren't visible in the sky for some reason!
[*] Our system would crash due to a bug when selecting a zone. This has been fixed as well.
[*] Some achievements couldn't be obtained. This has also been corrected.
[/list]

That's all for now! Have fun, boss!
